title: Hungry Polar Bear Ambushes Seal | The Hunt | BBC Earth

segments.description: Medium wide shot of a lean polar bear walking across floating ice sheets in the Arctic ocean [[00:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zNO0kxTClYo&t=1)].
Medium close-up shot of the polar bear stopping and scanning the horizon across the icy expanse [[00:11](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zNO0kxTClYo&t=11)].
Medium tracking shot of the polar bear stepping cautiously over frozen ridges and broken ice chunks [[00:23](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zNO0kxTClYo&t=23)].
Wide scenic shot of the polar bear standing atop an ice floe against a backdrop of distant arctic mountains [[00:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zNO0kxTClYo&t=30)].
Medium close-up shot of the bear peering over an ice ridge to locate a resting seal [[00:50](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zNO0kxTClYo&t=50)].
Medium action shot of the polar bear slipping quietly into the water to make a stealthy approach [[01:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zNO0kxTClYo&t=66)].
Close-up shot of a ringed seal resting comfortably on a slab of ice unaware of the danger [[01:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zNO0kxTClYo&t=82)].
Medium tracking shot of the polar bear swimming silently through frigid waters to get downwind [[01:37](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zNO0kxTClYo&t=97)].
Medium action shot of the polar bear suddenly bursting out of the water onto the ice floe to ambush the seal [[01:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zNO0kxTClYo&t=119)].
Close-up action shot of the underwater struggle as the polar bear successfully captures the seal [[02:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zNO0kxTClYo&t=150)].
Medium shot of the polar bear dragging its prey onto the ice to feed, securing vital sustenance [[02:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zNO0kxTClYo&t=163)].
Wide landscape shot of the lone polar bear feeding on the ice under a heavy, overcast Arctic sky [[03:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zNO0kxTClYo&t=185)].
